shared_elements: elaborate headdress/cap covering the forehead with repeated raised elements
ears rendered as projections flanking the head
schematic frontal face with heavy brow and closed lips/mouth line
blocky columnar massing of the head atop the body/block
justification: Both depict a frontal, heavily schematic human head crowned by a close-fitting headdress whose front edge sits low over the brow with repeated raised units, with the ears projecting at the sides and a broad flat-lipped mouth below — a reasonably specific shared scheme of massive frontal portraiture. The chief difference in depicted content is that A continues below the head into a torso bearing incised emblematic motifs (discs, concentric circles, banded chest ornaments) and a fringed, vertically ruled headdress, whereas B shows only the head with a lobed/scalloped cap and bared teeth and no body iconography.
